lines: 第1章不怪她
浙海省杭港市。
文成初中三七班。
“这次模拟考大家的进步都是有目共睹的，特别是秦守同学考了全年级第二，离满分就差了2分，大家要多向他学习。”
“大多数同学都是好样的，而个别有些同学不求上进竟然考了个零分，硬生生把班级平均分拉下来。”
“这里我就不指名道姓了，只希望这位同学好自为之，离中考只有21天了，这样的成绩别说御兽高中就连普通职高都考不上。”
地中海班主任余光扫向最右边倒数第三排靠窗的位置，只见那位置上的扎马尾女生正襟危坐，腰板挺的直直的，一副三好学生的模样。
他嘴角不由抽了抽，装什么装！说的就是你！
乔桑当然知道班主任说的是自己，可她没办法啊，她又不是这个世界的乔桑。
她前两天才穿过来，都还没适应就赶上了模拟考。
不过一个初中的模拟考而已，她当然不怕，她上辈子怎么说也是考上了985院校的高材生。
可试卷一到手她就懵了。
【人类脑域觉醒形成的是什么？】
【心鳞对什么超凡生物有吸引力，又能起到什么样的作用？】
【臭臭鳅的最终进化形态叫什么？】
【人类已移民的星球都有哪些？】
这……这些问题都什么啊？！
最后没办法，她只能选择题三长一短选短，三短一长选长，填空题乱填，问答题空白交卷。
这两天乔桑适应了身体，原主的记忆也涌了上来，她对这世界大概也了解了。
这是个以御兽为主的世界，从人类发现自己能御兽后到现在发展也有3205万年的时间，已经形成了绝对成熟的御兽社会体系。
说是御兽时代但也不是全民御兽，人类到15岁的时候脑域就能通过磁波的刺激来觉醒出御兽典。
这个御兽典是契约也是空间，能完美的连接人类跟超凡生物的关系。
若是到15岁的时候脑域不能觉醒，那大概率这辈子就跟御兽没什么关系了。
虽然御兽时代发展了几千万年，但人类还是不能百分百能觉醒出御兽典。
就去年来说，全国中考统一觉醒出御兽典的考生只占了73%，有27%的考生没有觉醒，就算他们中有人是学神，也注定了不能考上御兽高中。
而不能御兽的人只能沦为平庸，终其一生在社会阶级的下层。
这是个很现实的问题，不能御兽你可能连搬砖都干不了。
有徒手一次性能搬几百kg甚至几千kg砖的超凡生物谁还用人力来搬，费时又费力。
连端盘子也是这样。
就算工资比人高出好几倍，餐厅也宁愿请超凡生物来端，因为这样能吸引更多的顾客。
在这样跟以前社会常识全然不同的世界，乔桑作为临近中考的初中生心里那个急啊！
以前是知识改变命运，现在是御兽改变人生。
她虽然有了原主的记忆，但原主她是个学渣啊！
成绩常年稳定在全班倒数第三，上个月的模拟考倒是进步了，考了个全班倒数第四。
不过那是因为以前的倒数第四考试那天拉肚子弃考了两门。
21天后就中考了，她也不期望考个重点高中，现在能上个高中就谢天谢地了。
乔桑认真的听老师讲课，做笔记，直到下课还拿着课本一直看着，简直拿出了当年临近高考的冲刺态度。
“乔桑，老班说的鸭蛋是你吧。”同桌方思思压着声音凑了过来。

Chapter 1 Don’t blame her
Hanggang City, Zhehai Province.
Class 37 of Wencheng Junior High School.
"Everyone's progress in this mock test is obvious to all, especially Qin Shou, who ranked second in the grade, just 2 points away from the perfect score. Everyone should learn more from him."
"Most of the students are good, but some students did not seek to improve and even got a zero in the exam, dragging down the class average."
"I won't name names here. I just hope that this classmate can take care of himself. There are only 21 days until the high school entrance examination. With such results, let alone Yushou High School or even ordinary vocational high schools."
The Mediterranean class teacher glanced at the window seat in the third row from the far right, and saw the girl with a ponytail sitting upright, with her back straight, looking like a good student.
The corners of his mouth twitched involuntarily, what are you pretending to be? It’s you!
Of course Qiao Sang knew that the head teacher was talking about her, but she couldn't help it. She was not the Qiao Sang of this world.
She had just worn it two days ago, and she had to take the mock test before she even got used to it.
It was just a mock exam for junior high school, so she was certainly not afraid. In her previous life, she had been admitted to the 985 College as a top student.
But as soon as she got the test paper, she was confused.
[What is formed by the awakening of the human brain? 】
[What extraordinary creatures are the heart scales attractive to, and what role can they play? 】
[What is the final evolutionary form of the Stinky Loach called? 】
[What are the planets that humans have immigrated to? 】
This...what are these questions? !
In the end, she had no choice but to choose three long and one short multiple-choice questions, choose short, three short and one long, choose long, fill in the blanks randomly, and hand in blank questions.
In the past two days, Qiao Sang had adapted to her body, and the memories of the original owner had come back to her. She probably understood the world.
This is a world dominated by beast-controlling. It has taken 32.05 million years since humans discovered that they could control beasts, and an absolutely mature social system for beast-controlling has been formed.
It is said to be the era of beast control, but it is not the era of beast control for all people. When humans are 15 years old, their brains can awaken the beast control code through the stimulation of magnetic waves.
This beast control code is both a contract and a space, which can perfectly connect the relationship between humans and extraordinary creatures.
If the brain cannot awaken by the age of 15, then there is a high probability that it will have nothing to do with beast control in this life.
Although the era of beast control has developed for tens of millions of years, humans are still not 100% able to awaken the beast control code.
Just last year, only 73% of the candidates in the national high school entrance examination had awakened to the Beast Control Code, and 27% of the candidates had not awakened. Even if some of them were gods of learning, they were destined not to be admitted to the Beast Control High School.
People who cannot control beasts can only be reduced to mediocrity and spend their entire lives at the bottom of the social class.
This is a very real problem. If you can't control the beast, you may not even be able to move bricks.
There are extraordinary creatures who can carry hundreds or even thousands of kilograms of bricks with bare hands at a time. Who would use human power to move them, which is time-consuming and laborious.
Even the dishes are served like this.
Even if the salary is several times higher than that of a human being, the restaurant would rather hire extraordinary creatures to serve food because it can attract more customers.
In this world that is completely different from the previous social common sense, Qiao Sang, as a junior high school student who is about to take the high school entrance examination, feels so anxious!
In the past, knowledge changed destiny, but now it is beast control that changes life.
Although she has the memory of the original owner, she was a scumbag!
My grades have been consistently ranked third from the bottom in the class all year round. Last month’s mock test actually improved, and I got fourth from the bottom in the class.
But that was because I had diarrhea and dropped out of two exams on the fourth-to-last exam day.
She will take the high school entrance examination in 21 days, and she doesn't expect to go to a key high school. She is thankful to be able to go to a high school now.
Qiao Sang listened carefully to the teacher's lectures, took notes, and kept reading with the textbook in hand until the end of get out of class. He almost showed the sprinting attitude he had when the college entrance examination was approaching.
"Qiao Sang, the duck egg that my boss is talking about is you, right?" Fang Sisi, the classmate at the table, lowered her voice and came over.
